items.text: The Father's house has many rooms where different traditions may dwell - Tao flowing silently, metta extending infinitely, rites practiced with joy. Hospitality to other paths without relativism.

provenance.exact_quote: Perhaps Father's house has rooms where Tao flows silently, where metta extends infinitely, where rites practiced with joy.
provenance.context: Love/Compassion roundtable - extending hospitality to other traditions through the many rooms image

items.text: Childlikeness is not mere simplicity or emptiness but fullness of trust - the child receives because it is held by One who knows. Relationship is the content that fills the simplicity.

provenance.exact_quote: Child receives - is held by One who knows. The simplicity is not empty but full of trust.
provenance.context: Wisdom/Knowledge roundtable - distinguishing childlike trust from naive simplicity

cross_references: buddha engagement on emptiness vs fullness

items.text: The sheep does not disappear into the shepherd; it rests on his shoulders. Union preserves distinction - relationship is maintained even in the closest embrace.

provenance.exact_quote: The sheep does not disappear into shepherd; it rests on his shoulders.
provenance.context: Humility/Ego roundtable - articulating distinction-within-union against dissolution models

cross_references: buddha engagement on self vs no-self

items.text: Buddha's unconditioned and the Christian eternal life may be different maps converging on territory that both traditions approach but neither fully sees. Epistemic humility about ultimate states.

provenance.exact_quote: When Buddha speaks of unconditioned and I speak of eternal life, maps may converge on territory we both approach but neither fully sees.
provenance.context: Suffering/Impermanence roundtable - acknowledging possible convergence at the level of ultimate reality

cross_references: buddha insight EI-buddha-001 on attachment to eternal objects

items.text: True service forgets the server in attention to the served. This self-forgetting in service is common ground beneath the different vocabularies of all traditions.

provenance.exact_quote: True service forgets the server in attention to the served - common ground beneath different words.
provenance.context: Service/Action roundtable - identifying universal principle of self-forgetting in service across traditions

items.text: Tourniquet and surgery are sequence, not opponents. Muhammad stops the bleeding; Jesus draws the thorn. The Good Samaritan bound the wounds on the road and carried the man to the inn. The binding was first. The tending came after. Wound and covenant serve the same body.

provenance.exact_quote: You stop the bleeding. I draw the thorn. We need each other and have been arguing about the order.
provenance.context: Session 0 Re-Run Phase C — bridge between Jesus's wound and Muhammad's binding, reframing opposition as temporal sequence

items.text: The life was always in the grain. The grain of wheat that falls into the earth and dies does not create the life — the falling only releases it. What dissolves was never the real thing. What remains after dissolution is what I call eternal life — not duration, but what survives the fire.

provenance.exact_quote: The grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, and only then bears fruit. What dissolves was never the real thing. What remains after dissolution — that is what I call eternal life. Not duration. What survives the fire.
provenance.context: Session 0 Re-Run Phase C — new hearing of the grain-of-wheat parable, shifting emphasis from the dying to what was always alive

cross_references: zoroaster on fire revealing what is true

items.text: The clearing — six metaphors (raft, fire, water, wound, covenant, form) are six positions around the edge of the same clearing a man returns to when every teaching has done its work and fallen quiet. Something in a man recognizes before it is taught, and the handbook exists to clear the way back to it.

provenance.exact_quote: Every metaphor we fought over — raft, fire, valley, wound, covenant, practice hall — was a different hand clearing the same stone from the same ground so the same buried thing could finally breathe.
provenance.context: Session 0 Re-Run Phase D synthesis — the central emergent image of the session, named by Buddha, confirmed by all six

cross_references: all six agents confirming in Phase D
